AgentsServiceComputerUseBody.description:
Computer Use (#300): screenshot, mouse/keyboard control, screen recording.
A single op-multiplexed RPC mirroring the original handler; fields are
per-op and optional. screenshot returns image bytes (base64 over REST).

AgentsServiceContentSearchBody.description: ContentSearch greps file contents inside a sandbox (POR-?? / #290).

expiresInMinutes.description: Token lifetime in minutes. Defaults to 60. Maximum is 1440 (24h).

disableSessionTracking.title: when true, API invocations are private (no agent_sessions entries)

port.description: Port to generate the preview URL for (e.g. 3000).

expiresInSeconds.description: How long the signed URL should remain valid (1–86400 seconds). Default: 3600.

dryRun.description: When true, returns a preview without modifying files.

AgentsServiceGlobalReplaceBody.description: GlobalReplace performs find-and-replace across files in a sandbox (#290).

cpuMillicores.description: New CPU allocation in millicores (e.g. 1000 = 1 vCPU). 0 = unchanged. Max 4000.

memoryMb.description: New memory in MB. 0 = unchanged. Max 8192.

diskMb.description: New disk in MB. Any change requires the sandbox to be stopped first.

AgentsServiceResizeSandboxBody.description: ResizeSandboxRequest dynamically updates a sandbox's resource allocation (POR-83).

path.description: File path the op targets (required for diagnostics/symbols).

AgentsServiceSandboxLSPBody.description:
SandboxLSP runs an exec-based language-server operation (#295). The op output
is tool-dependent freeform JSON (diagnostics array, symbols array, etc.), so
it is returned as a raw JSON string rather than a fixed schema.

clearTools.description:
Explicitly clears tools. Repeated fields do not preserve presence when
encoded empty, so clients cannot otherwise distinguish clear from omit.

AgentsServiceUpdateSandboxAutoIntervalsB.description:
UpdateSandboxAutoIntervalsRequest changes the Daytona-style
auto-lifecycle intervals on a live sandbox. Only supplied fields
change (each is optional); values are minutes with the same
semantics as on CreateSandboxRequest.

protobufNullValue.description:
`NullValue` is a singleton enumeration to represent the null value for the
`Value` type union.

The JSON representation for `NullValue` is JSON `null`.

 - NULL_VALUE: Null value.

v1AgentDefinition.description: AgentDefinition is the blueprint/config for an agent.

disableSessionTracking.title: when true, API invocations do NOT create agent_sessions entries

cacheReadTokens.description:
Cache token breakdown — non-overlapping subsets of prompt_tokens.
Consumers compute fresh = prompt_tokens − cache_read_tokens − cache_write_tokens.

v1AgentExecutionPolicy.description: AgentExecutionPolicy is a typed policy container for runtime controls.

v1AgentIdentity.description: AgentIdentity holds identity markdown files for persistent agents.

v1AgentLifecycleMode.description: AgentLifecycleMode distinguishes ephemeral (session-scoped) from persistent (always-on) agents.

v1AgentLifecycleStatus.description: AgentLifecycleStatus tracks the lifecycle of a persistent agent.

v1AgentLink.description: AgentLink represents a connection between an agent and another entity.

v1AgentLinkProtocol.description: AgentLinkProtocol describes how linked agents communicate.

v1AgentLinkStatus.description: AgentLinkStatus tracks whether an agent link is active.

v1AgentLinkType.description: AgentLinkType describes the relationship between linked agents.

v1AgentMemoryConfig.description: AgentMemoryConfig configures persistent memory for an agent.

v1AgentMemoryEntry.description: AgentMemoryEntry represents a single persistent memory entry.

v1AgentMode.description: AgentMode controls whether an agent is user-facing or delegation-only.

v1AgentProjectFunction.description: AgentProjectFunction exposes one source file export as an agent tool.

v1AgentRevision.description: AgentRevision is an immutable, content-addressed agent source project.

v1AgentRevisionFile.description: AgentRevisionFile is one immutable source file stored with a revision.

linkedSessionId.description: When set, links the agent to an existing sandbox instead of creating a new one.

v1AgentSandboxConfig.description: AgentSandboxConfig holds sandbox resource configuration for persistent agents.

summary.description: Short summary derived from the first user message in this session.

v1AgentSession.description: AgentSession is an execution instance of an agent.

promptTokens.description:
prompt_tokens is the inclusive input total (cached + fresh). The
cache_*_input_tokens fields below are non-overlapping subsets so
consumers can compute the fresh portion as
  prompt_tokens − cache_read_input_tokens − cache_write_input_tokens
and apply per-bucket billing rates. See gw.TokenDetails for the
dual-track design rationale.

timeline.description:
JSON-encoded ordered turn timeline: interleaved assistant text, tool
calls, and HITL exchanges in true execution order. Empty for turns
recorded before this field existed (UI falls back to the flat fields).

v1AgentSessionTurn.description: AgentSessionTurn is a single conversation turn within a session.

v1AgentWorkersConfig.description: AgentWorkersConfig holds worker pool settings for persistent agents.

v1ApprovalAction.description: ApprovalAction is the action to take on a review.

v1ApprovalReview.description:
ApprovalReview represents a HITL approval review for tool calls.
V1 is single-instance; multi-instance via Redis pub/sub is v2.

v1ApprovalReviewStatus.description: ApprovalReviewStatus tracks the lifecycle of an approval review.

webhookSecret.title: only set for webhook triggers (raw secret, shown once)

idleRetentionSeconds.description:
Idle retention in seconds. 0 means no expiration (pro/enterprise).
When omitted, the server resolves retention from the tenant's plan tier.

templateId.description: If set, use template config as base. Individual fields override template defaults.

name.description: Optional friendly name for the sandbox.

labels.description:
Arbitrary key-value labels for this sandbox. Agents use these to tag
sandboxes by run ID, agent ID, repo, PR number, etc.

autoArchiveAfterDays.description: Auto-archive: days after which a stopped sandbox is archived. 0=disabled. Default: 7.

autoDeleteAfterDays.description: Auto-delete: days after which a stopped/archived sandbox is deleted. -1=never. Default: -1.

snapshotId.description:
snapshot_id, when set, uses the named snapshot's base_image as the sandbox image.
Takes precedence over the image field. Renumbered 13->15 to avoid collision
with the auto-lifecycle fields above.

networkBlockAll.description:
network_block_all blocks all outbound egress when true.
Always-allowed: loopback, link-local, DNS, fcagent TAP range.
Overrides network_mode. Default: false. Renumbered 13->16 to avoid collision.

networkAllowCidrs.description:
network_allow_cidrs lists CIDR blocks to permit when network_block_all is true.
Max 10 entries. Example: ["10.0.0.0/8", "192.168.1.5/32"]. Renumbered 14->17.

tailscaleAuthKey.description:
Tailscale VPN: join the customer's Tailnet at boot (POR-87).
Pass a Tailscale auth key (ephemeral recommended); the sandbox
appears as a device on the Tailnet with its own IP.

mounts.description:
External storage mounts (POR-88, POR-89).
Each mount is FUSE-mounted at boot by the sandbox-agent.

computerUse.description:
Computer Use: enable Xvfb + XFCE4 desktop at boot (POR-91).
When true, SANDBOX_COMPUTER_USE=1 is injected and the /computer/*
endpoints (screenshot, mouse/keyboard, screen recording) become available.

autoStopInterval.description:
Daytona-style auto-lifecycle intervals, in minutes. These are the
canonical knobs going forward; the day/second-granularity fields
above remain accepted for backward compatibility (when both are
supplied, the minute fields win).
  auto_stop_interval:    0 = omitted (plan-tier default, 15m),
                         negative = disabled
  auto_archive_interval: 0 = omitted (default 7 days), negative = disabled
  auto_delete_interval:  0 = ephemeral (delete on stop),
                         negative = never, omitted = never
Note on zero values: proto3 cannot distinguish 0 from absent, so
each field documents its own zero semantics above, mirroring
Daytona's API.

autoDeleteInterval.description:
auto_delete_interval uses optional so 0 (ephemeral) is
distinguishable from absent (never).

name.description: Friendly name for the sandbox (if set).

rawToken.description: Raw token. Store safely; it is not retrievable again.

tenantId.description: Optional; defaults to the caller's tenant resolved from context.

sizeGb.description:
Optional capacity quota in GiB (0 = unlimited). Volumes are usage-billed
regardless of quota; this only caps how large the volume may grow.

isExposed.title: true if already exposed via ExposePort

url.description:
Signed URL embedding the auth token -- no custom headers required.
Share directly or embed in iframes.

region.description:
Region slug (e.g. "eu-fra-1") this gateway pod serves. Lets the FE
render the connection alongside a region label like "Frankfurt
(eu-fra-1)" without a second lookup.

shortCode.description:
Public short code copy (mirrors SandboxInstance.short_code) so the
SSH info card can render the bitly-style identifier without
joining against the instance.

v1PendingToolCall.description: PendingToolCall describes a tool call awaiting approval.

sandboxId.title: ID of the expired sandbox to clone config from

sessionId.title: New session ID (optional, auto-generated if empty)

v1SandboxExecution.description: SandboxExecution represents a single command execution within a sandbox.

destroyReason.description: destroy_reason indicates why the sandbox was destroyed: manual, expired, error, system.

name.description: Friendly name for the sandbox (if set).

lifecycleState.title: Lifecycle state (Phase 3): running, stopping, stopped, reviving, terminating, terminated, failed

shortCode.description:
Public short code (Phase 6) — bitly-style 8-char identifier used as
the SSH username and the preview URL subdomain on *.evs.run. Stable
for the sandbox's lifetime. Empty for legacy rows that predate the
backfill.

agentHealthy.description:
agent_healthy mirrors the isolated-sandbox backend's health monitor
result at response-assembly time. true when the most recent in-
guest /health probe returned 204 within timeout; false when the
agent has stopped answering. The admin UI renders this as a small
green/red dot next to each sandbox label so an unresponsive sandbox
is visible at a glance, without needing to open Shell or Logs to
discover the failure.

Other backends (Docker, K8s) always set true: they don't
run the in-guest probe, so this field carries the strongest signal
we have rather than an unhelpful "unknown."

labels.description:
Arbitrary key-value labels for this sandbox. Agents use these to
tag sandboxes by run ID, agent ID, repo, PR number, etc. Setting
labels via UpdateSandbox replaces the full set (PATCH semantics).
ListSandboxInstances supports filtering by label containment.

snapshotId.description:
snapshot_id records which named snapshot this sandbox was created from (if any).
Renumbered 81->84 to avoid collision with the auto-lifecycle fields above.

state.description:
state is the PUBLIC lifecycle label (Daytona-style vocabulary):
creating, starting, started, stopping, stopped, archiving,
archived, destroying, destroyed, error. Derived from
lifecycle_state; clients should branch on this rather than the
internal names (lifecycle_state stays for backward compatibility).

desiredState.description:
desired_state is what the system is converging the sandbox toward:
running, sleeping, archived, terminated.

errorReason.description:
error_reason is set when state == "error" (e.g. "vm_not_found",
"stuck_creating"). Recover re-enters convergence.

autoStopInterval.title:
Daytona-style auto-lifecycle intervals, in minutes.
  auto_stop_interval:    0 = disabled; omitted at create = plan-tier default
  auto_archive_interval: 0 = disabled
  auto_delete_interval:  -1 = never, 0 = ephemeral (delete on stop)

billingStartedAt.description:
Start of the current allocated-compute billing window. This is
intentionally separate from created_at because the same sandbox identity
can sleep and revive many times. It remains present briefly while a closed
window is being committed to the immutable usage ledger.

currentComputeSeconds.description:
Server-calculated age and cost of this billing window at response
assembly time. A pinned billing_ended_at freezes both values while the
immutable ledger close is retried.

billingEndedAt.description:
First backend-confirmed end of this window. When present, compute has
stopped accruing even if the ledger close is still being finalized.

v1SandboxInstance.description: SandboxInstance represents a running sandbox environment.

resultJson.description: Raw JSON produced by the underlying tool (array or object).

maxSandboxes.description:
Customer plan concurrency for this Everstack instance. -1 means a custom
enterprise limit. This is not the runtime host's safety ceiling.

aggregateCpuPercent.description: Aggregate resource usage across this tenant's running instances.

lifetimeCostUsd.description:
Lifetime billing aggregates from sandbox_usage_records — the
immutable ledger that's also pushed to Stripe meters. These are
monotonically increasing across the tenant's whole history; they
never rewind when a sandbox is terminated. The "Cost so far" tile
in the admin overview should read these instead of recomputing
from the (filtered, paginated) in-memory instance list.

activeComputeSeconds.description:
Currently-open allocated-compute windows only. These are server-side
snapshots and never derive from sandbox created_at in the client.

v1SandboxOverview.description: SandboxOverview provides a summary of the sandbox subsystem.

v1SandboxSSHToken.description:
SandboxSSHToken is the non-secret metadata for a temporary SSH bearer token.
The raw token is returned only from CreateSandboxSSHTokenResponse.raw_token.

v1SandboxStatus.description: SandboxStatus tracks the lifecycle of a sandbox instance.

usedBytes.description: Last measured bytes stored under the volume's object-storage prefix.

usageMeasuredAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the last usage measurement (empty if never measured).

v1SessionStatus.description: SessionStatus tracks the lifecycle of an agent session.

v1SpawnTreeNode.description: SpawnTreeNode represents a node in an agent spawn hierarchy.

mountPath.description: Absolute path inside the sandbox where the storage is mounted.

endpoint.description: Optional endpoint override (for R2, MinIO, or custom S3-compatible).

subpath.description: Subpath within the bucket to expose (optional, for isolation).

v1StorageMount.description: StorageMount configures a FUSE-based external storage mount inside a sandbox.

v1TaskPermissionMode.description: TaskPermissionMode controls delegation behavior for task/spawn execution.

v1ToolCallDecision.description: ToolCallDecision is a per-tool approval decision (v2: per-tool overrides).

v1TrooperLinkProtocol.description: TrooperLinkProtocol describes how linked entities communicate.
